title: The Loch Ness Monster — Episode 1: The Accident

exercises.instructionEn: Sandra Manning and David Parr are reporters. They work for The Morning Sun in London. Mike Battle is the editor of the newspaper.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU NIMA?
Enterprise kitobida har bir moduldan keyin RASMLI HIKOYA keladi.
U unit emas — alohida epizod. Hikoya butun kitob davomida davom etadi.

1-EPIZOD: 'The Accident' (Baxtsiz hodisa)
Mavzu: Loch Ness ko'lidagi afsonaviy maxluq.

LOCH NESS — Shotlandiyadagi katta va chuqur ko'l.
'Loch' — shotlandcha 'ko'l' degani.
Afsonaga ko'ra u yerda 'Nessie' laqabli ulkan maxluq yashaydi.
Bu haqda 1930-yillardan beri gapiriladi, lekin ishonchli dalil yo'q.

QAHRAMONLAR:
  Mike Battle   — muharrir (editor)
  Sandra Manning — muxbir (reporter)
  David Parr     — muxbir (reporter)
  The Morning Sun — gazeta nomi

tasks.en: Sandra Manning and David Parr are reporters.
tasks.uz: Sandra Manning va Devid Parr — muxbirlar.
tasks.note: reporter — gazeta yoki televideniye uchun yangilik yig'uvchi.

tasks.en: They work for The Morning Sun in London.
tasks.uz: Ular Londondagi 'The Morning Sun' gazetasida ishlaydi.
tasks.note: 'work FOR' — biror tashkilotda ishlamoq. Gazeta nomi qiya yoziladi.

tasks.en: Mike Battle is the editor of the newspaper.
tasks.uz: Mayk Betl — gazetaning muharriri.
tasks.note: editor — muharrir, gazetaning boshlig'i. U muxbirlarga topshiriq beradi.

exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing — har bir rasm va gapning tarjimasi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYA TARTIBI (rasmlar bo'yicha):
  1) Gazeta idorasida — Mayk muxbirlarni chaqiradi
  2) Mayk topshiriq beradi — Loch Nessga borish
  3) Poyezdda — Sandra shubhalanadi
  4) Loch Nessda — qayiq ijaraga olishadi
  5) Uch soatdan keyin — maxluq paydo bo'ladi
  6) Sandra suvga yiqiladi — BAXTSIZ HODISA

DIQQAT — bu epizodda BUYRUQ GAPLARI juda ko'p:
  Look at this!    Go to Loch Ness!    Sit down!
  Be careful!      Don't stand up!     Help me!
Ular 25-betdagi 'The Imperative' qoidasida tushuntiriladi.

tasks.en: IN "THE MORNING SUN" OFFICES... — Sandra! David! Look at this.
tasks.uz: 'THE MORNING SUN' IDORASIDA... — Sandra! Devid! Bunga qarang.
tasks.note: Mayk gapiryapti. 'Look at this' — buyruq gapi.

tasks.en: What is it, Mike?
tasks.uz: Bu nima, Mayk?
tasks.note: Sandra so'rayapti.

tasks.en: There are stories about the Loch Ness Monster in all the papers today, but there aren't any photographs!
tasks.uz: Bugun barcha gazetalarda Loch Ness maxluqi haqida maqolalar bor, lekin hech qanday surat yo'q!
tasks.note: Unit 3 grammatikasi! There are ... but there aren't ANY ... . 'papers' = 'newspapers' ning qisqasi.

tasks.en: Go to Loch Ness. I want a story and photographs with it!
tasks.uz: Loch Nessga boringlar. Menga maqola va u bilan birga suratlar kerak!
tasks.note: 'Go' — buyruq. 'I want' — xohishni bildiradi.

tasks.en: ON THE TRAIN... — Is there really a monster, David?
tasks.uz: POYEZDDA... — Rostdan ham maxluq bormi, Devid?
tasks.note: 'Is there ...?' — Unit 3 savol shakli. 'really' = rostdan ham.

tasks.en: Maybe!
tasks.uz: Balki!
tasks.note: maybe = balki, ehtimol.

tasks.en: AT LOCH NESS... — Can you see the monster?
tasks.uz: LOCH NESSDA... — Maxluqni ko'ryapsanmi?
tasks.note: 'Can you see ...?' — ko'rish qobiliyati haqida savol.

tasks.en: No, I can't. Let's hire a boat and look for it.
tasks.uz: Yo'q, ko'rmayapman. Qayiq ijaraga olib, uni qidiraylik.
tasks.note: 'Let's ...' — 'kel(ing)...aylik' taklifi. 'look for' = qidirmoq. 'hire' = ijaraga olmoq.

tasks.en: AFTER THREE HOURS ON THE BOAT... — Sandra! Look! The monster! Can you see it? Wow! It's huge!
tasks.uz: QAYIQDA UCH SOATDAN KEYIN... — Sandra! Qara! Maxluq! Ko'ryapsanmi? Voy! U ulkan!
tasks.note: 'huge' — Unit 3 lug'atidan (ulkan).

tasks.en: Where is it? I can't see it! Quick, take some photographs!
tasks.uz: U qayerda? Men ko'rmayapman! Tez bo'l, suratga ol!
tasks.note: 'Quick' va 'take' — buyruq. 'take a photograph' = suratga olmoq.

tasks.en: Sandra, be careful! Sit down! Don't stand up!
tasks.uz: Sandra, ehtiyot bo'l! O'tir! O'rningdan turma!
tasks.note: Uchta buyruq: ikkitasi tasdiq, bittasi INKOR ('Don't stand up').

tasks.en: OH NO! HELP!!!! DAVID!!! HELP ME!
tasks.uz: VOY! YORDAM BERING!!! DEVID!!! MENGA YORDAM BER!
tasks.note: Sandra suvga yiqildi — epizod nomi shundan: 'The Accident' (baxtsiz hodisa).

tasks.en: VROOOOM
tasks.uz: VRRRR (qayiq motorining ovozi)
tasks.note: Komikslarda tovushni bildiruvchi so'zlar. Inglizchada ular boshqacha: it — 'woof', mushuk — 'meow', qo'ng'iroq — 'ring ring'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 24 and point to the editor, the reporters and the monster. What do you know about the Loch Ness monster?
exercises.instructionUz: 24-betdagi rasmlarga qarang va muharrir, muxbirlar hamda maxluqni ko'rsating. Loch Ness maxluqi haqida nima bilasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
Rasmlarda kim kim:
  the editor    — Mayk Betl (keksaroq erkak, ko'zoynakli, qizil bantli)
  the reporters — Sandra (sariq sochli ayol) va Devid (qora sochli erkak)
  the monster   — ko'lda ko'ringan uzun bo'yinli kulrang maxluq

tasks.en: The Loch Ness Monster is a creature from Scottish stories.
tasks.uz: Loch Ness maxluqi — Shotlandiya afsonalaridagi jonzot.
tasks.note: creature = jonzot, maxluq.

tasks.en: People call it "Nessie".
tasks.uz: Odamlar uni 'Nessi' deb atashadi.
tasks.note: 'call' — atamoq, chaqirmoq.

tasks.en: Loch Ness is a big, deep lake in Scotland.
tasks.uz: Loch Ness — Shotlandiyadagi katta va chuqur ko'l.
tasks.note: deep = chuqur. 'loch' shotlandcha 'ko'l'.

tasks.en: There are a lot of stories about Nessie, but there aren't any real photographs.
tasks.uz: Nessi haqida ko'p hikoyalar bor, lekin haqiqiy suratlar yo'q.
tasks.note: Unit 3 grammatikasi: a lot of ... but ... aren't ANY ...

tasks.en: Many tourists go to Loch Ness every year.
tasks.uz: Har yili ko'p sayyoh Loch Nessga boradi.
tasks.note: tourist = sayyoh. Nessie afsonasi Shotlandiyaga sayyoh keltiradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
Uchta gap hikoyaning turli joyidan olingan.
Hikoyani boshidan oxirigacha eslang:

  2) Ko'l bo'yida qayiq ijaraga olishadi
  3) Qayiqda Sandraga ogohlantirish beriladi

tasks.prompt: 2  There are photographs of the monster in all the papers.
tasks.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Mayk aytadi: 'there aren't ANY photographs!' Aynan shuning uchun ularni jo'natyapti.
tasks.speak: 2  There are photographs of the monster in all the papers.

tasks.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Sandra aytadi: 'Where is it? I can't see it!'

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QOIDA:

  IN — yopiq joy yoki narsa ICHIDA:
       in the office, in his hand, in the papers

  ON — transport vositasi USTIDA:
       on the train, on a boat, on a bus, on a plane

TRANSPORT QOIDASI — muhim:
  ON  — poyezd, avtobus, samolyot, qayiq, velosiped
        (ichida yurish mumkin bo'lgan katta transport)
  IN  — mashina, taksi
        (kichik, o'tirib yuriladigan)

  ✅ on the train / on a boat / in a car
  ❌ in the train / in a boat

'in the papers' — gazetada YOZILGAN degani (sahifa ichida).

tasks.prompt: 1  David and Sandra are ____ the office.
tasks.whyUz: Idora — yopiq joy → IN the office.
Qo'lda ushlab turibdi → IN his hand. 'on his hand' — qo'l ustida yotibdi degani.

tasks.prompt: 3  There are stories about the monster ____ all the papers.
tasks.whyUz: Gazeta ICHIDA yozilgan → IN the papers.

tasks.prompt: 4  Sandra and David are ____ the train.
tasks.whyUz: Katta transport → ON the train. 'in the train' NOTO'G'RI.

tasks.prompt: 5  Sandra and David are ____ a boat.
tasks.whyUz: Qayiq ham transport → ON a boat.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode again and find eight sentences which are orders. Who says each sentence?
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni qayta o'qing va buyruq bo'lgan sakkizta gapni toping. Har birini kim aytadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Hikoyada AYNAN SAKKIZTA buyruq bor.
Namuna: Look at this. (Mike)

Ularni topish osonlashtiruvchi belgi:
  • gap FE'L bilan boshlanadi (ega yo'q)
  • ko'pincha undov belgisi (!) bilan tugaydi

Kim aytadi:
  Mike   — 2 ta (idorada topshiriq beradi)
  David  — 4 ta (Sandrani ogohlantiradi)
  Sandra — 2 ta

tasks.whyUz: 'Sandra! Look! The monster!' — eng qisqa buyruq, bitta so'z.
'Sandra! Look! The monster!' — eng qisqa buyruq, bitta so'z.
'be' — 'to be' fe'lining asos shakli. Buyruqda 'are' emas, 'be' ishlatiladi.
'be' — 'to be' fe'lining asos shakli. Buyruqda 'are' emas, 'be' ishlatiladi.
YAGONA inkor buyruq: don't + asos shakl.
YAGONA inkor buyruq: don't + asos shakl.

rule.explanationUz:
Buyruq mayli — kimgadir NIMA QILISHNI aytish.
Bu ingliz tilidagi ENG SODDA gap turi: ega yo'q, zamon yo'q,
faqat FE'L.

  Look at this.    — Bunga qara.
  Go to Loch Ness. — Loch Nessga bor.
  Sit down!        — O'tir!

O'zbekchada buyruq qo'shimcha bilan yasaladi (qara, bor, o'tir).
Inglizchada esa fe'lning ASOS SHAKLI o'zgarishsiz ishlatiladi.

rules.enRule: We form affirmative orders or instructions with the base form of the verb.

rules.uzRule: INKOR buyruq — don't + fe'lning asos shakli.
rules.enRule: We form negative orders or instructions with don't + base form of the verb.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — ega qo'shish:
  ❌ You look at this.   ✅ Look at this.
  ❌ You don't stand up. ✅ Don't stand up.

Buyruqda 'you' AYTILMAYDI — u o'z-o'zidan tushuniladi.

Va fe'l HECH QACHON o'zgarmaydi:
  ❌ Looks at this.  ❌ Looking at this.  ❌ To look at this.
  ✅ Look at this.
rule.noteUz:
MULOYIM QILISH:
Buyruq qo'pol eshitilishi mumkin. Yumshatish uchun 'please' qo'shiladi:
  Sit down.        — O'tir. (buyruq)
  Please sit down. — Iltimos, o'tiring. (muloyim)
  Sit down, please. — ham to'g'ri

'Let's ...' — birgalikda qilishga taklif, buyruq emas:
  Let's hire a boat. — Qayiq ijaraga olaylik.
rule.extraUz:
BUYRUQ QAYERDA UCHRAYDI:
  • ko'rsatmalarda: Open your books. Turn left.
  • ogohlantirishda: Be careful! Don't touch!
  • retseptlarda:   Add the salt. Mix well.
  • belgilarda:     Push. Pull. Do not enter.

Rasmiy yozuvda 'don't' o'rniga 'do not' yoziladi:
  Do not stand up. (rasmiy)
  Don't stand up.  (og'zaki)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and make sentences using object pronouns, as in the example. Look at her!
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va obyekt olmoshlari bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna: Look at her!

RASMLAR:
  1) ayol            → her
  2) sirk artisti (erkak) → him
  3) kenguru (hayvon)     → it
  4) bir guruh erkaklar   → them

QOIDA: 'at' — predlog, undan keyin DOIM obyekt shakli keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Change the subject pronoun into the object pronoun.
exercises.explanationUz: Butun jadvalni yodlab olish — bu grammatikaning asosi.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida olmosh gapdagi VAZIFASIGA qarab shaklini o'zgartiradi.

  EGA (fe'ldan OLDIN)      OBYEKT (fe'ldan KEYIN)
  I                        me
  you                      you
  he                       him
  she                      her
  it                       it
  we                       us
  you                      you
  they                     them

Misol:
  SHE is Sandra.   — She — ega, fe'ldan oldin.
  Look at HER.     — her — obyekt, fe'ldan keyin.

O'zbekchada bu 'u' va 'unga/uni' farqiga o'xshaydi.

rules.enRule: Subject pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, you, they) go before verbs as their subjects.
examples: They work for The Morning Sun.

rules.enRule: Object pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, you, them) go after verbs as their objects.

rule.warningUz:
PREDLOGDAN KEYIN ham OBYEKT shakli keladi:
  ✅ Look at HER.     ❌ Look at she.
  ✅ with ME          ❌ with I
  ✅ for THEM         ❌ for they

Oson qoida: fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — DOIM obyekt shakli.
rule.noteUz:
'you' va 'it' o'zgarmaydi — ikkala vazifada ham bir xil:
  YOU are a reporter.  /  I can see YOU.
  IT is huge.          /  Look for IT.

Qolgan oltitasi o'zgaradi: I/me, he/him, she/her, we/us, they/them.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the speech bubbles with sentences from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Nutq pufakchalarini ro'yxatdagi gaplar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (hammasi BUYRUQ gapi):
  • Don't be afraid!     — Qo'rqma!
  • Don't worry. It's gone. — Xavotir olma. U ketdi.
  • Take my hand!        — Qo'limdan ushla!
  • Put this on.         — Buni kiy.

Har bir rasmda VAZIYAT bor — unga mos javobni toping.
Berilgan namuna: 1-rasmda ayol 'I'm cold' (Sovqotdim) deydi.

2-rasm — daraxt orqasidagi ayiqdan qo'rqqan ikki kishi — tinchlantiruvchining gapi
3-rasm — suvdagi odam qirg'oqdagi odamga qo'l cho'zadi — yordam beruvchining gapi

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the puzzle to find Mike's job.
exercises.instructionUz: Krossvordni to'ldiring va Maykning kasbini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
Oltita rasm — oltita so'z. Har bir so'zdan bitta harf
vertikal ustunga tushadi va Maykning kasbini hosil qiladi.

  1  gazeta rasmi   → PAPER      (4-harf: E)
  2  yozuv stoli    → DESK       (1-harf: D)
  3  poyezd         → TRAIN      (4-harf: I)
  4  suratli ramka  → PHOTOGRAPH (4-harf: T)
  5  qayiq          → BOAT       (2-harf: O)
  6  maxluq         → MONSTER    (7-harf: R)

  Vertikal: E - D - I - T - O - R  =  EDITOR (muharrir)

Va haqiqatan ham: 'Mike Battle is the editor of the newspaper.'

exercises.instructionUz: Xatboshini o'qing va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu xatboshi — butun epizodning QISQA XULOSASI.
Har bir bo'shliqda birinchi harf va harflar soni berilgan.

TO'LIQ MATN:
'Mike Battle is the editor of The Morning Sun. David and Sandra
are reporters. In the office, Mike shows David and Sandra some
papers. There are stories about Nessie, the monster in Loch Ness,
in all of them. David and Sandra go to Scotland on a train. They
want to take photographs of Nessie. There are boats by the loch.
David and Sandra hire one to look for Nessie. After three hours
on the boat, David sees the monster behind Sandra.'

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to show — ko'rsatmoq
  by      — yonida (by the loch = ko'l yonida)
  one     — bittasi (boats o'rniga: hire ONE = bittasini ijaraga olmoq)
  Scotland — Shotlandiya

exercises.instructionEn: Write descriptions of Mike, Sandra and David.
exercises.instructionUz: Mayk, Sandra va Devidning tavsifini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ODAM TAVSIFI — Unit 2 mavzusi, bu yerda qayta ishlatiladi.

NIMANI YOZISH KERAK:
  1) ismi va kasbi        — He is ... He is a ...
  2) qayerda ishlaydi     — He works for ...
  3) tashqi ko'rinishi     — He is tall/short, he has got ... hair
  4) hikoyada nima qiladi  — In the story, he ...

Quyidagi namunalar — shu to'rt qadam bo'yicha.
24-betdagi rasmga qarab, tashqi ko'rinishni to'ldiring.

tasks.answer: This is Mike Battle. He is the editor of The Morning Sun.
He is an older man with short grey hair and glasses.
In the story, he gives David and Sandra a new job: go to Loch Ness and take photographs of the monster.
This is Sandra Manning. She is a reporter and she works for The Morning Sun in London.
She is young and slim with long fair hair.
In the story, she goes to Loch Ness with David. She can't see the monster and she falls into the water.
This is David Parr. He is a reporter and he works with Sandra.
He is young and tall with short dark hair.
In the story, he sees the monster first and he tells Sandra to be careful.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ishni bajaruvchi odam nomi fe'ldan yasaladi. Ba'zilari -er, ba'zilari -or oladi — buni yodlab olish kerak.
Fe'lga predlog qo'shilsa, ma'no butunlay o'zgaradi. Ularni ALOHIDA so'z kabi yodlash kerak.
Angliya va Shotlandiya joy nomlarida uchraydi.
Olmosh gapdagi vazifasiga qarab shaklini o'zgartiradi. Fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — obyekt shakli.
Buyruqda fe'l ASOS shaklida qoladi: -s, -ing, 'to' qo'shilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are ... BUT there aren't any ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are stories about the monster in all the papers, but there aren't any photographs!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Barcha gazetalarda maxluq haqida maqolalar bor, lekin hech qanday surat yo'q!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Unit 3 grammatikasi hikoyada ishlatilyapti.
Tasdiqda 'some' yoki hech narsa, inkorda 'any'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there really a monster, David?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'really' shubhani bildiradi — 'rostdan ham?'.
U 'there' va 'a' orasida turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can you see ...? — No, I can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you see the monster? — No, I can't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi: 'No, I can't' (I can't see it EMAS).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Let's hire a boat and look for it.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Let's' = 'let us' — birgalikda qilishga taklif.
Keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida keladi ('to' YO'Q): Let's GO (Let's to go EMAS).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at this! Go to Loch Ness! Sit down!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bunga qarang! Loch Nessga boring! O'tir!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Buyruqda EGA yo'q — gap to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'ldan boshlanadi.
Bu 25-betdagi 'The Imperative' qoidasi.
Inkor buyruq — 'don't' + fe'l. Har doim 'don't' (doesn't EMAS).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at this! Sit down! Be careful!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tasdiq buyruq. Ega YO'Q — gap to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'ldan boshlanadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Don't stand up! Don't be afraid! Don't worry.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Inkor buyruq. Har doim 'don't' — ega qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Look at her. Help me! Look for it. Look at them!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Unga qara. Menga yordam ber! Uni qidir. Ularga qara!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin — doim obyekt shakli (me, him, her, it, us, them).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's Sandra. They work for The Morning Sun.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U — Sandra. Ular 'The Morning Sun' da ishlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'ldan oldin — ega shakli (I, you, he, she, it, we, they).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mike shows David and Sandra some papers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mayk Devid va Sandraga gazetalarni ko'rsatadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'show' ikkita to'ldiruvchi oladi: KIMGA + NIMANI.
Tartib: show + odam + narsa (predlogsiz).

sentencePatterns.formula: on a train / on a boat — transport.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: David and Sandra go to Scotland on a train.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devid va Sandra poyezdda Shotlandiyaga boradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Katta transport bilan ON. Faqat mashina va taksi bilan IN.
